bull_bear.title: Bull — competitive strengths

bull_bear.body:
- No operating business — The erstwhile manufacturing facility and the furniture business remain discontinued and the Company had no manufacturing or trading operations during the year, so there is no revenue from operations to support the entity.
- Interest rate risk on a deposit-only income base — Principal assets are office premises and fixed deposits with banks and income is derived substantially from interest earned thereon; management explicitly states the Company 'remains exposed to interest rate risk'.
- Fixed regulatory and listing compliance costs against no operating income — The Company continues to incur fixed regulatory and listing compliance costs while earning only interest income, which keeps the entity structurally loss-making at the pre-tax level.
- Undefined future business direction — The Board is still evaluating options for the prudent deployment of surplus funds and for the Company's future business direction; no successor business has been identified.
- Disposal of the last operating asset to a related party — The remaining office premises are being sold to The New Great Eastern Spinning and Weaving Company Limited, a promoter group company, leaving the Company holding cash and only a 250 sq. ft. leave-and-license footprint in the same premises.
- Concentration in and dependence on the promoter group — The transaction of scale during the year was with a promoter group company, and the Company's continued occupation of premises depends on a leave and license arrangement with that same counterparty.
bull_bear.title: Bear — key risks

outlook.body: There is no capex or expansion programme. The Company's erstwhile manufacturing facility and its furniture business remain discontinued and it has no manufacturing or trading operations; its principal assets are office premises and fixed deposits placed with banks. The only property action disclosed is a disposal rather than an addition — the Board and shareholders (postal ballot results declared 31 March 2026) approved the sale of the 1,340 sq. ft. office premises at Jolly Bhavan No. 1, New Marine Lines, Mumbai to The New Great Eastern Spinning and Weaving Company Limited, a promoter group company, with a three-year leave and license arrangement for 250 sq. ft. in the same premises. The Board will continue to evaluate options for the prudent deployment of surplus funds and for the Company's future business direction.

outlook.body:
- Income is derived substantially from interest earned on fixed deposits placed with banks, so earnings track deposit interest rates rather than any operating demand
- Total income increased during FY 2025-26 primarily due to higher interest income on fixed deposits
- Following completion of the approved sale of office premises, the Company's liquid resources are expected to increase further
- The Company remains exposed to interest rate risk while continuing to incur fixed regulatory and listing compliance costs
